title: I/O SubmissionManager and file-data performance rollout
summary: Replace the coarse filesystem-I/O staging path with independent L4 and device-scoped L6 owners, separated page-cache synchronization domains, bounded resident publication, multi-page reads, device-aware request shaping, real readahead, and candidate-bound correctness and performance receipts. Multi-queue remains conditional on accepted single-queue saturation evidence.

steps.title: Align canonical I/O ownership and publication contracts
steps.notes: Markdown Task 1. Move the approved owner, custody, publication, readahead, and measurement contracts into active docs before changing implementation behavior.

steps.title: Repair ext4 production frontier settlement prerequisite
steps.notes: Markdown Task 2. Close the real transaction-frontier and supported fsync settlement path before performance extraction. Verify the existing immutable Tier 1 receipt only; do not run a fresh crash campaign here.

steps.title: Add bounded observation and capture the locked single-page baseline
steps.notes: Markdown Tasks 3-4. Instrument the current staging path without policy changes, bind fixed geometry and trace-loss accounting, and retain the result as the locked/single-page/single-queue baseline.

steps.title: Extract and cut over the shared L4 PageIoSubmissionManager
steps.notes: Markdown Tasks 5-6. Introduce neutral owned-bundle admission first, then make one shared L4 manager the sole production owner with exactly one terminal settlement.

steps.title: Add typed device limits and extract device-scoped L6 ownership
steps.notes: Markdown Tasks 7-8. Physical devices own immutable finite limits and one L6 manager; partitions share that manager while retaining bounds in their handles.

steps.title: Split PageState and Range owner domains from resident state
steps.notes: Markdown Task 9. Keep PageSlot FSM and range reservation serialized under separate owners; no lock or claim crosses planner, device, yield, or wait boundaries.

steps.title: Strengthen bounded publication and cut over persistent ResidentRoot
steps.notes: Markdown Tasks 10-12. Reserve retirement capacity during prepare, keep commit bounded and infallible, then publish a path-copy persistent root with active/generation/pin revalidation.

steps.title: Extend the canonical lease and graph path to multi-page reads
steps.notes: Markdown Tasks 13-14. Extend the existing PageDataLease, PageIoCompletion, and BackendBioGraph families; preserve holes, extent boundaries, per-page generations, and partial-failure settlement.

steps.title: Add device-limit splitting, compatible merging, and short plugging
steps.notes: Markdown Task 15. Split before mutable admission, merge only within immutable device and ordering limits, aggregate pieces once, and flush bounded plugs at service-turn and barrier boundaries.

steps.title: Add bounded adaptive and explicit file-data readahead
verification: cargo xtask test io-submission-witness --target rv64-qemu --case readahead --smp 4 --timeout-ms 120000
steps.notes: Markdown Task 16. Key bounded sequential history by PageContainer and open-file stream, reuse the canonical request family, preserve demand priority, and make readahead(2) a real advisory admission path.

steps.title: Run final correctness campaign and select the performance candidate
verification: cargo xtask ext4 tier1 --run-id io-submission-p8-$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)
cargo xtask ext4 tier1 --verify-receipt target/ext4/tier1/io-submission-p8-$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)/acceptance-receipt.json
steps.notes: Markdown Task 17. Run short gates first, then exactly one fresh candidate-bound Tier 1 campaign with failure-point resume, and require five interleaved matched A/B pairs before production selection.

steps.title: Close or implement the evidence-gated device multi-queue candidate
steps.notes: Markdown Task 18. A false trigger is a valid completed negative result and creates no shard set. A true trigger permits only an L6/driver candidate that passes the declared throughput, latency, trace-loss, barrier, and exactly-once A/B gates.

steps.title: Reconcile active contracts and close immutable progress evidence
steps.notes: Markdown Task 19. Document only receipt-proven production behavior, bind both immutable receipts and the P9 decision, close every stage, and remove no staging language without production callsite evidence.

verification.notes: Passed on 2026-08-05; seven pre-existing active-doc stale-vocabulary discussion warnings remain non-fatal.
Passed on 2026-08-05 for 43 progress JSON records including this proposed plan and the canceled Phase 0 ledger.
Scoped whitespace validation passed for exactly the four planning artifacts.

risks: Custody extraction can leave two live owners if compatibility fallbacks survive production cutover; every cutover task must prove one authority and exactly-one settlement.
Resident publication can become unsafe if prepare does not reserve retire capacity or if a reader treats immutable lookup as frame-lifetime evidence without pin revalidation.
Multi-page and split completion can double-settle or leak custody under partial failure unless parent and per-page generation accounting are tested together.
Readahead can hide random-read regression through unreported amplification; requested, useful, unused, canceled, duplicate, demand bytes, and device bytes remain separate receipt facts.
Performance selection is invalid under geometry drift, missing trace-loss accounting, fewer than five interleaved pairs, or an unverified candidate-bound Tier 1 receipt.
Multi-queue can add complexity without benefit; it remains absent unless the accepted single-queue receipt triggers it and the sharded A/B gate passes.
blockers: Implementation has not started; activate and claim only the current stage after choosing an execution workflow.
The final fresh ext4 Tier 1 campaign is deferred to P8 so multi-hour prefixes are not rerun after every intermediate stage.
BlockQueueShardSet is conditional and may remain absent when P8 evidence does not prove hardware and L6 saturation.
